observations.content: User provided context-only preparation packets 1–8/12 for a later implementation task: change project-level durable `.memory/` into `.memory/<immutable sessionId>/`, seed a child/fork's memory from its parent's session-specific root exactly once on first touch by resolving the session header's `parentSession` path and reading the parent header ID, never use display names or filename IDs as identity, skip transient `.runs/`, leave child root uncreated when parent header/root is unreadable or absent until a durable write, and never overwrite/reseed existing child memory on resume.

The later task requires all durable-memory reads/writes, compaction memory-map rendering, journey access, and worker IPC to use the owning session's memory root; preserve existing short-term ledger `/tree` behavior and keep durable per-session files independent from ledger branches.

Provided project reference describes observational-memory extension with event-driven master orchestrator and recorded headless pi observer/consolidator workers; short-term observations are branch-local ledger entries with coverage watermarks and `/tree` rollback, while durable files currently live project-wide under `.memory/` and do not roll back.

Reference implementation has `.memory/` substrate in `src/memory/paths.ts` (`memoryDir(cwd)`, INDEX/JOURNEY paths, atomic writes, topic enumeration) and worker IPC in `src/spawn/runs.ts` (`.memory/.runs/<runId>.*`); consolidator tools are scoped to `OM_MEMORY_DIR`, supplied by `buildWorkerEnv` in `src/spawn/launch.ts`.

Compaction rendering in `src/hooks/compaction-hook.ts` reads JOURNEY.md and renders the topic map using `ctx.cwd`; consolidator triggering builds prompts from topic index and journey, runs the worker, tombstones its handed active batch, and rerenders INDEX.md. These are areas implicated by the requested per-session root change.

The reference states Phase A and Phase B are implemented; project README describes default-OFF `/om` gate, observer/consolidator subprocesses, journey, memory map, cost tracking, and `/tree` semantics. Config defaults in `src/config.ts` include chunkTokens 10000, poolTargetTokens 10000, consolidateAtPoolTokens 15000, compactAtContextTokens 100000, tailTokens 20000, journeyTargetTokens 1000, and observerConcurrency 4.
